text:
- **Search retrieval model:** `pm search` now ranks whole records and items with BM25 OR matching, shown at each hit's best unit. The strict eval showed no clear gain over rg or newest-first ordering.
- **Cross-repo PR review:** The pm service now raises, closes, and sprint-closes reviews of PRs in other GitHub repos. A merge watcher stores that PR's merge after it lands.
- **Repo improvement proposals:** The owner chose sprint proposals as the only way to make repo improvements, so repo feedback was dropped. This repo's pm version pin moved to a newer release, and proposal work has started.
- **Project overview page:** The overview now lists open projects first. Closed projects fold into one collapsed section at the bottom.
